title: How it works
text: Candidates complete short, real projects (2-4 weeks) for partner organizations. When the organization approves the work, the candidate earns a verified skill badge. Hiring partners can see badges on candidate profiles.

title: Time commitment
text: Projects need 3-8 hours per week, as listed on each project. The minimum is 3 hours per week.

title: Badges
text: Organizations review submitted work within 7 days. A badge is issued when the work is rated "meets expectations" or higher. If not, the candidate can resubmit once.

title: Getting stuck
text: If an organization does not reply within 5 working days, contact the pilot coordinator. The coordinator replies within 48 hours.

title: Jobs
text: Hiring partners may invite candidates with badges to interviews. Proofwork does not guarantee a job.

title: Projects at once
text: يمكنك العمل على مشروعين كحد أقصى في الوقت نفسه. يجب إنهاء مشروع واحد على الأقل قبل البدء بمشروع ثالث.
